files.name: Invitation to join adly.news
files.title: Invitation to join adly.news
files.preview:
Hey!

I came across The Recount while looking at newsletters about Government & Law and thought it was a great fit for something I'm working on.

I'm building adly.news: a free marketplace that helps newsletters get inbound sponsorships from relevant brands, without having to chase deals over email. We have a direct integration with Beehiiv, so setup only takes a few minutes.

We already have businesses looking for newsletters like yours:
• Anchor Point Research

If you're interested, you can sign up here: https://adly.news/newsletter. Totally understand if not!

Thanks,
Phil
